spans.s: कु-वंग n. lead.

कु-वचस्, -वाक्य (I) a. abusive, scurrilous, using bad language.
कु-वाक्य (II) n. abuse, bad language.
कु-वर्ष m. a sudden and violent shower.
कु-विवाह m. a degrading or improper marriage, M.iii.63.
कु-वृत्ति f. bad behaviour.
कु-वैद्य m. a bad physician.
कुबे(वे)र m. The god of riches and the regent of the northern quarter, कुबेरगुप्तां दिशमुष्णरश्मौ गंतुं प्रवृत्ते समयं विलंब्य K.S.iii.25.
कुबे(वे)र-अद्रि, -अचल m. An epithet of Mountain Kailāsa.
कुबे(वे)र-अद्रि, -अचल m. An epithet of Mountain Kailāsa.
कुबे(वे)र-दिश् f. the north.
कुव n. 1. A flower; 2. a lotus.
कुवर m. See तुवर.
कूपा(वा)र m. The ocean.
कूब(व)र (I) a. (f. री) 1. Beautiful, agreeable; 2. hump-backed.
कूब(व)र (II) m.n. The pole of a carriage to which the yoke is fixed.
कूब(व)र (III) m. A hump backed man.
कुवल n. 1. The water-lily; 2. a pearl; 3. water.
कुवलय n. 1. The blue water-lily, कुवलयदलश्यामोऽप्यंगं दधत्परिपांडुरम् M.M.v.; 2. a water-lily in general; 3. the earth.
कुवलयिनी f. 1. An assemblage of lotuses; 2. a place abounding in lotuses; 3. the lotus plant.
कुवाद a. (f. दा) A tell-tale, low, vile, means.
कुवाद a. (f. दा) A tell-tale, low, vile, means.
कुविक m. pl. The name of a country.
कुविं(पिं)द m. 1. A weaver, कुविंदस्त्वं तावत्पटयसि गुणग्राममभितः K.Pr.vii.; 2. a name of the weaver caste.
कुवेणी f. A basket to hold fish when caught.
कुवेल n. A lotus.
कूब(व)री f. 1. A carriage covered with a cloth; 2. the pole of a carriage to which the yoke is fixed.
